state.text: Image 1 is the reference state. Image 2 is the current state. Compare the visible equipment state, ignoring changes in viewpoint and lighting.

same_state.instructions: Do Image 1 and Image 2 show the same equipment state? Select review when the relevant parts are hidden or unclear.

criteria.yes: The visible equipment state matches the reference.
criteria.no: The visible equipment state differs from the reference.
criteria.review: The images do not provide enough visible evidence to decide.
